title: Mirror Path Reflection
description: A woman with extremely long, flowing multicolored hair sits on a stone bench in a surreal night corridor lined with glowing rectangular mirrors and picture frames. The wet reflective ground shows her silhouette under the light of ornate lampposts while pink petals are scattered around her.
prompt: A lone woman with extremely long flowing hair in shades of purple, green and white sits on a stone bench with her back to the viewer, gazing at glowing rectangular mirrors and picture frames that line a long corridor. Wet reflective ground, ornate glowing lampposts, pink petals scattered on the floor, dark mountains and green foliage in the background, surreal dreamlike fantasy scene, atmospheric night lighting.
